topic: Limiting relative flange outstand or flange-plate slenderness of beam-columns
notes: For 5<m_x<=20, interpolate linearly to the corresponding bending-member limit at m=20 from 8.5.18 or 8.5.19.
Member slenderness below 0.8 or above 4 is taken as 0.8 or 4 respectively.
Clause 9.4.8 multiplies the resulting limit by 1.5 for qualifying edge returns.
